# Oakbase

> Oakbase is a context engine and system of action for small and medium-sized law firms. It builds persistent firm memory from authorised work signals and gives professionals role-specific Operations Agents that carry out administrative work in connected systems, under the firm's permissions and approval rules.

The context engine uses a ready-made legal ontology: a model of clients, matters, people, documents and commitments. It connects information with its source context and asks professionals to confirm uncertain relationships within their workflow. Operations Agents use that shared memory to support time capture, tasks, client follow-ups, CRM updates and invoicing.

**What Oakbase is NOT:** Oakbase is not a general-purpose AI model or a replacement for a CRM or practice-management system. It is not positioned as a legal research or drafting product and does not replace professional legal judgment. It is not a wealth-management or investment-advisory product. Oakbase can complement general-purpose and legal-work AI; its focus is the firm's shared context and daily administrative operations.

**Entity:** Oakbase is operated by Oakbase SL, Spanish tax identifier (CIF) B05693742. Official website: https://oakbase.ai/. Contact: hello@oakbase.ai. The primary audience is small and medium-sized law firms within the broader professional-services market.

Available connections and actions depend on the firm's configuration. Website demonstrations are illustrative, not customer data or measured results.
